step1_analysis.circuit_type: Pseudo-differential Operational Transconductance Amplifier (OTA) with Common-Mode Feedforward (CMFF)
step1_analysis.description: A fully balanced pseudo-differential OTA that uses a common-mode feedforward (CMFF) circuit (XM2, XM7, XM3, XM4, XM6) to detect the input common-mode voltage and inject a canceling common-mode current at the outputs. This achieves high common-mode rejection (CMRR) without requiring a tail current source, maximizing voltage headroom.

paper_reference.title: A pseudo-differential fully balanced fully symmetric CMOS operational transconductance amplifier (OTA) architecture with inherent common-mode detection

sky130_expected.calculation: Ad = gm_n * (ro_n || ro_p). With Vcm=0.6V, Id~43uA, gm~486uS, Rout~77kOhm. Ad = 37.4 V/V = 31.4 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using SKY130 typical parameters for 5u/0.5u devices at 43uA bias current.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGBW = gm_n / (2 * pi * Cload). With gm=486uS and Cload=1pF, UGBW = 77.3 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches closely with the paper's 100 MHz filter application, adjusted for 1pF test load.

sky130_expected.calculation: CMRR = Ad_db - Acm_db. If W_xm3 = 2 * W_xm4, the CMFF perfectly cancels common-mode current, yielding very high CMRR.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the matching of the PMOS current mirror ratio (W_xm3 vs W_xm4/6).

Power_Consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the OTA

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated for a single OTA stage. The paper's 42.9mW is for a complete complex filter system.

THD.description: Total Harmonic Distortion at 30 MHz for 900mVpp differential input

sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to be similar to the paper's reported value, as pseudo-differential pairs have good linearity when balanced.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure Differential Gain, UGBW, Phase Margin, CMRR, Power, and Transient Swing/THD.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Pseudo-differential OTA with CMFF Testbench

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Note: W_xm3 is set to 10u (2x W_xm4) to perfectly balance the CMFF DC currents and maximize CMRR.
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=10u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 VOUTM VIP VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 VIM VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VOUTM N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 VOUTP VIM VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 VOUTP N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N1 VIP VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}

* Supplies
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0

* DC Bias for outputs to prevent railing in open-loop
Vbias_out Vbias_out 0 0.9
L_outp VOUTP Vbias_out 1000H
L_outm VOUTM Vbias_out 1000H
C_outp VOUTP 0 1p
C_outm VOUTM 0 1p

* Inputs (DC=0.6V, AC diff=1V, Tran=900mVpp diff at 30MHz)
V_in_cm in_cm 0 0.6
V_in_d_p VIP in_cm dc 0 ac 0.5 sin(0 0.225 30Meg)
V_in_d_m VIM in_cm dc 0 ac -0.5 sin(0 -0.225 30Meg)

.control
  * 1. Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power
  print v(VOUTP) v(VOUTM) v(N1)

  * 2. Differential AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1 1G
  let vdiff = v(VOUTP) - v(VOUTM)
  let gain_diff_db = 20 * log10(mag(vdiff))
  let phase_diff = 180/PI * cph(vdiff)
  
  meas ac Ad_db find gain_diff_db at=100
  meas ac ugbw when gain_diff_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac phase_at_ugbw find phase_diff when gain_diff_db=0 fall=1

  * 3. Common-Mode AC Analysis
  alter V_in_d_p ac=1
  alter V_in_d_m ac=1
  ac dec 100 1 1G
  let vcomm = (v(VOUTP) + v(VOUTM))/2
  let gain_cm_db = 20 * log10(mag(vcomm))
  meas ac Acm_db find gain_cm_db at=100
  
  let cmrr_db = Ad_db - Acm_db
  print cmrr_db

  * 4. Transient Analysis & THD
  tran 0.1n 100n
  let vdiff_tran = v(VOUTP) - v(VOUTM)
  meas tran v_max max vdiff_tran
  meas tran v_min min vdiff_tran
  
  * Fourier analysis for THD at 30MHz
  fourier 30Meg vdiff_tran
  
  quit
.endc
.end
